task: Repair SDK REV evidence for ordinary, release and action-update PRs.

criteria.description: Reusable REV tests validate configuration relationships and collector behavior without assuming a rollout-only changed-file allowlist or requiring the consumed rev-pr-coverage changeset. The existing full-diff collector still rejects unmapped files, stale revisions and escaping evidence sources.

Only the changeset-release/main branch selects the release evidence profile. That profile uses a release-specific request and criteria, regenerates the release using bun install --frozen-lockfile and bun run version from an isolated merge-base checkout, and requires the complete tracked diff to match byte-for-byte, including removed changesets, new changelogs and lock metadata. Unrelated edits and tampered versions fail; worktrees are cleaned after success and failure. All changed paths are mapped to release-output and passed with exact revisions, complete diffs and reproduction observations to the pinned REV collector. No automatically generated candidate digest is treated as approval.

Keep pull-request scope, pinned evaluator, trusted PR-specific digest, existing required CI jobs and the secret-free evidence / artifact-only evaluator separation. Document release review requirements and ensure no merge or publish is performed by the evidence probe.

Dependabot checkout/setup-node major updates use a bounded action-update profile. The revision-bound probe accepts only upgrades of the requested action reference in workflow files, preserves all other bytes and file types, and rejects unrelated edits, downgrades and unsupported branches. Full diffs and probe evidence still undergo model review and all required CI checks. Other PRs must supply a matching pullRequest number and their own reviewed contract; inherited migration contracts fail with clear guidance. Collection errors identify the original failed job instead of reporting missing input artifacts. The evaluator and collector use the same immutable REV pin with bounded probability-rounding support; thresholds remain unchanged.

Stage a workflow_run evaluator on the default branch that uses the existing Actions TypeSafe secret with no PR code execution, dependency install or cache restore. Only immutable evaluator and action pins execute in that workflow. Verify the CI workflow identity, associated open PR and exact head/base, latest run attempt, all nine required job results and a unique fresh evidence artifact through GitHub. Download only that artifact ID to an isolated data directory; the pinned action validates revisions and the independently reviewed PR-specific contract. Publish REV trusted on the still-current PR head only for an approved report written outside the artifact directory. Invalid or stale inputs cannot approve. Keep the existing REV job during staged deployment until the new check is live and required; do not bypass a denial or require a separate Dependabot secret. Replace evidence artifacts on reruns and provide Bun for release reproduction.

Make the existing snapshot deadline regression test deterministic for QuickNode and regtest providers. Stall the first transport call independently of loopback server scheduling, require SAT_SNAPSHOT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED while it remains stalled, verify its request signal is aborted, and verify that a late response cannot start another read. Preserve a bounded test timeout and change no production SDK behavior.
